For example replace The Virginia Harmony with La Virginia Harmony or The Virginia Harmony rendered as The Virginia Harmony with Italian explanatory phrase if no established Italian title exists; preferred: The Virginia Harmony → The Virginia Harmony is acceptable only if no Italian rendering exists, but better to render as The Virginia Harmony → The Virginia Harmony. findings.location: Opening paragraph: "In the small cemetery of a churchyard in Olney, England, stands a granite tombstone" → Italian: "Nel piccolo cimitero di un camposanto a Olney"
findings.source_quote: "In the small cemetery of a churchyard in Olney, England, stands a granite tombstone"
findings.suggested_fix: The Italian text uses redundant wording "cimitero di un camposanto" (both mean cemetery/ churchyard). For clarity and idiomatic Italian, replace with "Nel piccolo cimitero della chiesa di Olney" or "Nel piccolo cimitero della chiesa parrocchiale di Olney". Preserve original HTML structure.
findings.translation_quote: "Nell piccolo cimitero di un camposanto a Olney, in Inghilterra, si trova una lapide di granito..."
